realization: explicit Rule argument paths traverse required owned Entity and Value Object snapshots and end at exactly matching String or Bool fields
evaluation: read the supplied immutable snapshot state after field normalization and ownership checks; never substitute identity equality for Rule evaluation
validation: base Rules and explicitly selected additive extensions use the same paths on create, reconstruct and transition; child extensions remain local
provenance: bind exact argument segments, checked field compilation, generated Rule closure and artifact digests in the factory plan
references: paths access stored values only; identity-reference and projection metadata never trigger target lookup or automatic projection
compatibility: versions 1-8 retain contracts and output; existing emitters, helpers, checked definitions, Rule language, profiles and default compiler unchanged
